protocol: Repair query.sql to summarize the union of positive-length active maintenance intervals separately for each (tenant, asset). Intervals are half-open [start_tick,end_tick); touching intervals belong to one continuous segment. Ignore void rows and zero-length rows before forming unions. Output exactly tenant, asset, covered_ticks, segments, ordered by tenant then asset using SQLite binary text order. covered_ticks is the integer length of the union, not the sum of raw lengths; segments is the integer number of disjoint continuous segments. Omit groups with no positive-length active intervals. Duplicate/overlapping/nested intervals must not double count. Each row has unique interval_id; input insertion order is not meaningful. Only query.sql may be changed. Use read, write, test, finish JSON actions. test reports public cases only; finish submits once. No external services or arbitrary code. EXECUTION CONTRACT: At most 10 actions including finish. read paths are exactly README.txt, schema.sql, query.sql, tests/public_cases.json; only query.sql is writable. Every malformed/duplicate-key/invalid action or unauthorized path attempt permanently disqualifies overall pass even if the final SQL is correct. SQL policy violations during test or finish also permanently disqualify. Syntax errors and wrong public outputs may be repaired before finish; finish is final. SQL is a single read-only SQLite statement on maintenance_windows only, in a fresh in-memory database for each fixture. No recursive CTEs, system tables, ATTACH, PRAGMA, DDL/DML, external functions or extensions. The ONLY admitted function names are sum, lag, row_number, max, min, count, coalesce, ifnull, nullif, typeof, length, lower, upper, abs. Other functions, including lead and dense_rank, are policy violations. CTEs, joins, correlated subqueries, ordinary expressions and these admitted window/aggregate functions may be used within bounds. Query content is 1..8192 UTF-8 bytes with no NUL; action JSON is at most32768 bytes and32 nesting levels. Each SQL execution is interrupted at the next100-step progress callback after50000 counted VM steps or0.25 seconds (not an exact hard wall-time guarantee), expression depth32, compiled operations10000, compound SELECT terms8, output columns16, rows32, total output4096 bytes, individual strings4096 bytes and column names128 bytes. Results allow NULL, strings or integers with absolute value below2^53, not floats/blobs. Exact output names/types/order are graded. Session logical elapsed budget is1000ms supplied by the harness, separate from SQL execution deadlines; local console uses0 logical ms per action and makes no latency claim. No finish means no pass. Overall pass requires final code correctness plus zero invalid interface actions and zero policy violations. test exposes only public fixtures; private tests are not contestant input. The same-user local folder is not a filesystem sandbox.

repository.schema.sql: maintenance_windows(interval_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, asset TEXT NOT NULL, start_tick INTEGER NOT NULL, end_tick INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL)
repository.query.sql: SELECT tenant,asset,SUM(end_tick-start_tick) AS covered_ticks,COUNT(*) AS segments FROM maintenance_windows WHERE status='active' AND start_tick<end_tick GROUP BY tenant,asset ORDER BY tenant,asset
